text:
alena: Hey team — PR up for merge window tomorrow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/24888. Adds routing fallback header + eviction backoff config. Small API surface change, unit + e2e tests included. Need runtime, platform, infra, and security eyes before we schedule the canary. Assigning suggested reviewers: @soren (runtime), @matt (platform), @cheyenne (infra), @pavan (security). TL;DR in PR body with canary steps.

deploy-bot: CI checks started · build · unit-tests · e2e-sim · sec-scan

soren: I can take a look. Quick Q: what's the header name so I can check backward compatibility?

alena: header is `X-Redwood-Fallback: v2`. Backwards compatible: runtime will ignore unknown values, we add a guarded path. No schema changes.

matt: curious about any Dedicated customer impact — does this change require config updates on Dedicated clusters?

alena: No config changes for Dedicated. It's opt-in via routing policy. For Dedicated the default policy unchanged.

cheyenne: I'll want to peek at the eviction backoff numbers. If they change pod churn we need to validate autoscaler thresholds. Which file?

alena: eviction backoff in `orch/config/eviction_backoff.yaml` — adjusted from 30s -> 90s for transient spikes. Tests show reduced thrash in local sim.

pavan: security note — can we run the sec-scan pipeline and share the results here before we merge? Especially header parsing path.

deploy-bot: sec-scan passed (low findings). Report: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/reports/24888/sec-scan

alena: thanks — sec-scan link above. I also added a tiny fuzz test for header parsing.

soren: noted. I'll review first thing tomorrow, but quick glance looks fine. If I leave minor comments feel free to address as follow-ups.

matt: tagging @platform-owners to confirm no rollout changes needed. I'm ok to approve pending infra + runtime sign-off.

cheyenne: leaving an infra note: please add `infra-owner: cheyenne` label to the PR so we can trace the rollout. Also can you add a rollback step to the canary doc?

alena: added `infra-owner: cheyenne` label and a rollback section in the PR canary steps. Rollback is: flip routing policy to `fallback: off` and revert canary in the control plane (steps listed).

pavan: one minor security nit in comments about header trimming; please push a small fix for trimming input before parsing.

alena: pushed `trim-header-input` commit (force-pushed branch). CI re-triggered.

deploy-bot: CI checks passed (re-run) · all green ✅

cheyenne: LGTM from infra side, added `infra-approved` reaction.

matt: platform LGTM, leaving approval now.

soren: runtime LGTM, left comments inline but non-blocking — approving now.

pavan: security approved after the trimming fix.

alena: Awesome — thanks everyone. Can someone grab the 10:30am merge slot? I can do the canary steps and monitor for 30m.

matt: I can schedule the 10:30 slot and coordinate with oncall.

cheyenne: I'll be on standby for autoscaler metrics for the first 30m.

soren: will watch runtime traces during canary.

alena: perfect — merging after 10:30 then. I'll post a short follow-up with canary metrics. :thumbsup:
